ZIG_VERSION.description: Specific version of zig to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

ZIG_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install ZIG. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools.

ZIG_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading zig binary or archive artifacts.

ZIG_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying zig available remote releases.
